avoid_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Forms insoluble complexes in GI tract, reducing levothyroxine absorption by 20-60%
avoid_supplements.action: Separate administration by at least 4 hours; take levothyroxine first on empty stomach

avoid_supplements.name: Iron supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Chelation complex formation reduces levothyroxine bioavailability by 20-50%
avoid_supplements.action: Separate by at least 4 hours; levothyroxine should be taken first

avoid_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Forms chelation complexes reducing GI absorption of levothyroxine
avoid_supplements.action: Separate administration by at least 4 hours

avoid_supplements.name: Aluminum hydroxide antacids
avoid_supplements.action: Separate by at least 4 hours; avoid concurrent use

caution_supplements.name: Zinc supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May reduce levothyroxine absorption when taken concurrently
caution_supplements.action: Separate administration by 2-4 hours if possible

caution_supplements.name: Soy isoflavones
caution_supplements.mechanism: May modestly reduce levothyroxine absorption in sensitive individuals
caution_supplements.action: Monitor TSH levels; adjust levothyroxine dose if needed

avoid_foods.name: High-dose soy products
avoid_foods.mechanism: Isoflavones may reduce levothyroxine GI absorption and increase metabolism
avoid_foods.action: Limit soy consumption or separate by several hours from levothyroxine dose

avoid_foods.name: Cruciferous vegetables in excess
avoid_foods.mechanism: Goitrogens may interfere with thyroid hormone synthesis and increase requirements
avoid_foods.action: Cook cruciferous vegetables and consume in moderation; maintain consistent intake

caution_foods.name: Fiber-rich foods
caution_foods.mechanism: High dietary fiber can reduce levothyroxine absorption when consumed concurrently
caution_foods.action: Take levothyroxine on empty stomach; wait 30-60 minutes before consuming fiber-rich foods

caution_foods.name: Coffee/caffeinated beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly reduce levothyroxine absorption and increase cardiac effects
caution_foods.action: Take levothyroxine with plain water; delay coffee consumption by 30+ minutes

caution_foods.name: Milk and dairy products
caution_foods.mechanism: Calcium content may reduce levothyroxine absorption
caution_foods.action: Avoid consuming with levothyroxine dose; separate by at least 4 hours

monitoring_notes: TSH and free T4 levels should be monitored 6-8 weeks after initiating therapy or any dose adjustment, as absorption interactions can affect thyroid hormone bioavailability and clinical efficacy. Patient education on proper administration (empty stomach, 30-60 minutes before food) is critical for therapeutic success.
